verses.en: Now as touching things offered unto idols, we know that we all have knowledge. Knowledge puffeth up, but charity edifieth.
verses.pt: E quanto às coisas sacrificadas aos ídolos, sabemos que todos temos conhecimento. O conhecimento incha de orgulho,mas o amor edifica.
verses.en_web: Now concerning things sacrificed to idols: We know that we all have knowledge. Knowledge puffs up, but love builds up.
verses.en_bbe: Now about things offered to images: we all seem to ourselves to have knowledge. Knowledge gives pride, but love gives true strength.

verses.en: And if any man think that he knoweth any thing, he knoweth nothing yet as he ought to know.
verses.pt: E se alguém acha saber alguma coisa, ainda nada conhece como se deve conhecer.
verses.en_web: But if anyone thinks that he knows anything, he doesn’t yet know as he ought to know.
verses.en_bbe: If anyone seems to himself to have knowledge, so far he has not the right sort of knowledge about anything;

verses.en: But if any man love God, the same is known of him.
verses.pt: Mas se alguém ama a Deus, o tal dele é conhecido.
verses.en_web: But if anyone loves God, the same is known by him.
verses.en_bbe: But if anyone has love for God, God has knowledge of him.

verses.en: As concerning therefore the eating of those things that are offered in sacrifice unto idols, we know that an idol is nothing in the world, and that there is none other God but one.
verses.pt: Portanto, quanto ao comer das coisas sacrificadas aos ídolos: sabemos que o ídolo nada é no mundo, e que não há qualquer outro Deus, a não ser um.
verses.en_web: Therefore concerning the eating of things sacrificed to idols, we know that no idol is anything in the world, and that there is no other God but one.
verses.en_bbe: So, then, as to the question of taking food offered to images, we are certain that an image is nothing in the world, and that there is no God but one.

verses.en: For though there be that are called gods, whether in heaven or in earth, (as there be gods many, and lords many,)
verses.pt: Porque, ainda que também haja alguns que se chamem deuses, seja no céu, seja na terra (como há muitos deuses e muitos senhores),
verses.en_web: For though there are things that are called “gods”, whether in the heavens or on earth; as there are many “gods” and many “lords”;
verses.en_bbe: For though there are those who have the name of gods, in heaven or on earth, as there are a number of gods and a number of lords,

verses.en: But to us there is but one God, the Father, of whom are all things, and we in him; and one Lord Jesus Christ, by whom are all things, and we by him.
verses.pt: Todavia para nós há só um Deus, o Pai, do qual são todas as coisas, e nós para ele; e um só Senhor Jesus Cristo, pelo qual são todas as coisas, e nós por ele.
verses.en_web: yet to us there is one God, the Father, of whom are all things, and we for him; and one Lord, Jesus Christ, through whom are all things, and we live through him.
verses.en_bbe: There is for us only one God, the Father, of whom are all things, and we are for him; and one Lord, Jesus Christ, through whom are all things, and we have our being through him.

verses.en: Howbeit there is not in every man that knowledge: for some with conscience of the idol unto this hour eat it as a thing offered unto an idol; and their conscience being weak is defiled.
verses.pt: Mas não há em todos este conhecimento; porém alguns até agora comem com consciência do ídolo, como se fossem sacrificadas aos ídolos; e sendo sua consciência fraca, fica contaminada.
verses.en_web: However, that knowledge isn’t in all men. But some, with consciousness of the idol until now, eat as of a thing sacrificed to an idol, and their conscience, being weak, is defiled.
verses.en_bbe: Still, all men have not that knowledge: but some, being used till now to the image, are conscious that they are taking food which has been offered to the image; and because they are not strong in the faith, their minds are troubled.

verses.en: But meat commendeth us not to God: for neither, if we eat, are we the better; neither, if we eat not, are we the worse.
verses.pt: Ora, a comida não nos faz agradáveis a Deus. Porque seja o que comamos, nada temos de mais; e seja o que não comamos, nada nos falta.
verses.en_web: But food will not commend us to God. For neither, if we don’t eat, are we the worse; nor, if we eat, are we the better.
verses.en_bbe: But God's approval of us is not based on the food we take: if we do not take it we are no worse for it; and if we take it we are no better.

verses.en: But take heed lest by any means this liberty of yours become a stumblingblock to them that are weak.
verses.pt: Mas tomai cuidado para que esta vossa liberdade não seja de maneira alguma escândalo para os fracos.
verses.en_web: But be careful that by no means does this liberty of yours become a stumbling block to the weak.
verses.en_bbe: But take care that this power of yours does not give cause for trouble to the feeble.

verses.en: For if any man see thee which hast knowledge sit at meat in the idol’s temple, shall not the conscience of him which is weak be emboldened to eat those things which are offered to idols;
verses.pt: Porque se alguém vir a ti, que tens este conhecimento, sentado à mesa no templo dos ídolos, não será a consciência do que é fraco induzida a comer das coisas sacrificadas aos ídolos?
verses.en_web: For if a man sees you who have knowledge sitting in an idol’s temple, won’t his conscience, if he is weak, be emboldened to eat things sacrificed to idols?
verses.en_bbe: For if a man sees you, who have knowledge, taking food as a guest in the house of an image, will it not give him, if he is feeble, the idea that he may take food offered to images?

verses.en: And through thy knowledge shall the weak brother perish, for whom Christ died?
verses.pt: E por causa de teu conhecimento, perecerá assim o irmão fraco, pelo qual Cristo morreu?
verses.en_web: And through your knowledge, he who is weak perishes, the brother for whose sake Christ died.
verses.en_bbe: And so, through your knowledge, you are the cause of destruction to your brother, for whom Christ underwent death.

verses.en: But when ye sin so against the brethren, and wound their weak conscience, ye sin against Christ.
verses.pt: Assim que, pecando contra os irmãos e ferindo sua fraca consciência, pecais contra Cristo.
verses.en_web: Thus, sinning against the brothers, and wounding their conscience when it is weak, you sin against Christ.
verses.en_bbe: And in this way, doing evil to the brothers, and causing trouble to those whose faith is feeble, you are sinning against Christ.

verses.en: Wherefore, if meat make my brother to offend, I will eat no flesh while the world standeth, lest I make my brother to offend.
verses.pt: Portanto, se a comida fizer cair ao meu irmão, nunca mais comerei carne, para que eu não faça ao meu irmão cair.
verses.en_web: Therefore if food causes my brother to stumble, I will eat no meat forever more, that I don’t cause my brother to stumble.
verses.en_bbe: For this reason, if food is a cause of trouble to my brother, I will give up taking meat for ever, so that I may not be a cause of trouble to my brother.
